title: console Setup › Apps: Delete and Disable report success for writes that changed nothing — handleDelete ignores reset:false, and handleToggleActive saves a package-owned app with no package scope
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · platform-core.app-management-toggle · C5b
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · platform-core.app-management-toggle · N1

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (`apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx`). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "app management page delete disable success toast but nothing changed reset false package scope" — 0 hits.

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, admin persona. Each case reproduced on two fresh loads by the runner; not a regression of the pin hop (no hop commit touches the page).

## Case 1 — Delete on a code-package app (clause C5b)

`/_console/apps/setup/system/apps` → "Delete Showcase" → "Confirm delete Showcase" → `DELETE /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app` → 200 `{success: true, reset: false, message: "No customization overlay found for app/showcase_app — already at artifact default."}`. The page shows the success toast **"Showcase deleted"** while the row stays "Showcase · Active" and `/meta/app` still lists `showcase_app` active after reload.

**Expected:** no "deleted" success — a neutral "nothing to reset" or an error. **Mechanism (objectui `1fb1ced36243`):** `handleDelete` does `await meta.deleteItem('app', name); toast.success(appDeleted)` without reading `reset`.

## Case 2 — Disable on an app in a writable package (clause N1)

Fixture: `POST /api/v1/packages` `{manifest: {id: 'com.qa.lanebapp', name: 'x', version: '0.1.0', type: 'app'}}`, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/lanebapp_app?package=com.qa.lanebapp` with an active app. In Setup › Apps, "Disable QA LaneB App" → `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/lanebapp_app` with `{...app, active: false}` and **no `?package=`** → 200 "Saved app 'lanebapp_app' (env-wide, state=active)". Toast **"QA LaneB App disabled"** — but the row stays Active, `GET /api/v1/meta/app/lanebapp_app` reads `active: true` with `_packageId: com.qa.lanebapp`, and the app switcher still lists it. `sys_metadata` now holds two `lanebapp_app` rows: the package row (`active: true`, served) and a new package-less env-wide row (`active: false`, never served).

**Expected:** the app goes inactive, or the write is refused and the page says so. **Mechanism:** `handleToggleActive` calls `meta.saveItem('app', app.name, {...app, active})` with no package scope; the same shape applies to Set default and the bulk actions on writable-package apps.

**Second landing point (server, objectstack-ai/objectstack):** a `PUT` without `?package=` on a package-owned item answers 200 while writing a row the reader never serves — the silent half. The nearest closed family there is objectstack-ai/objectstack#22128 / objectstack-ai/objectstack#21817 (package-less reads and writes of package-owned items); whether the server should refuse this write is that repo's call, and triage may split it out.
